theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Qs : ℕ → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ j, Module.finrank ℝ (Qs j) = n) → ∃ (js : ℕ → ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P) (κ : ℕ → ℝ), StrictMono js ∧ Orthonormal ℝ τ ∧ Tendsto κ atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ) (u : Euclid P), ‖(Qs (js i)).starProjection u - (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ)).starProjection u‖ ≤ κ i * ‖u‖
